descricao_produto: The product is a white Brazilian power strip with surge filter, shown in vertical orientation exactly like the photo: one flat rectangular body with rounded corners, about twice as tall as it is wide, matte white plastic, the front face covered with thin vertical ribbed grooves inside a smooth raised white border. The front face has two columns. Left column (narrow), from top to bottom: (1) one round white push button with a bright lime-green ring around it and a faint power symbol in its center; (2) one tiny red indicator dot just below the button; (3) four bright green USB-A ports stacked vertically close together, each a small horizontal rectangle; (4) one small gray oval USB-C port, the last item at the bottom of the left column. Right column (wide): exactly five identical white Brazilian three-pin sockets stacked vertically from top to bottom, each a raised, horizontally elongated hexagon with three round holes in a row, the middle hole slightly higher. One single round white cable comes out of the top edge of the strip, above the sockets. No logo, no printed text, no other colors, no other ports, no other buttons on the strip.
